title: Sasaki 2017: csa anatomical of psoas major at L4-L5 (F, supine)

imaging.modality: MRI 1.5 T Philips Achieva, axial T2 FSE
imaging.plane: axial slices parallel to the vertebral endplates at each disc level
imaging.posture_detail: supine (triangular pillows under head and knees for rounded backs)

quantity.name: csa_anatomical
quantity.definition: anatomical cross-sectional area of the muscle in the image plane (as cut, not corrected for fibre direction); total muscle outline area including intramuscular fat (fatty infiltration % reported separately, Table 3); mean of left and right

source.authors: Sasaki T, Yoshimura N, Hashizume H, et al.
source.sample: 796 adults (241 M, 555 F); community-dwelling Japanese adults (Wakayama Spine Study), ~39% with low back pain

how_to_simulate: Cut a plane through the L4-L5 disc parallel to the endplates.
Sum the anatomical CSA (PCSA/cos angle) of psoas elements crossing that plane, per side; compare the one-side value (paper = mean of left and right).
protocol.notes: Erector spinae and multifidus traced separately. Older Japanese community population.

extraction.check_notes: Table 2 values re-read from text; two decimal-point misprints noted. | verified 2026-11-12 independent check: OK (Table 2: women psoas L4/5 total 8.1+/-1.5 cm2; n=555; mean of bilateral sides per Methods)
